def piece_state(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    cont={(r,c) for r in range(34,44) for c in range(27,37)}
    pp={(r,c) for r in range(14,45) for c in range(14,44) if L[r][c]=='p' and (r,c) not in cont}

base=piece_state(current_frame)

    st=piece_state(current_frame)
    print(a,'->',st,'changed' if st!=base else 'no-op')
    if st!=base: base=st
